<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_AnnualAudit" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/annual-audit">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_AnnualAudit" name="Annual Audit Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_AuditRoles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditCoordinator" name="Audit Coordinator">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_AuditInitiated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Prep_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Prep_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareStatements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ComplianceTeam" name="Compliance Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CentralAuditTeam" name="Central Audit Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Review_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Discrepancy_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRisk_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Investigation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Investigation_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeFinalReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveFinalReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit Director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AuditInitiated" name="Audit process initiated"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send audit notification to regional office"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Split" name="Split: preparation activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareStatements" name="Prepare financial statements and gather documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check regulatory updates affecting audit"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Join" name="Join: preparation completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents to central audit team"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Review_Merge" name="Merge: submission or clarified documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submission"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" name="Discrepancies found?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestClarifications" name="Request clarifications from regional office"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide necessary clarifications"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split" name="Split: risk assessments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" name="Evaluate financial risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" name="Evaluate operational risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" name="Evaluate compliance risks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join" name="Join: risk assessments completed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" name="High risk identified?"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Investigation" name="Conduct detailed investigation">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Investigation" name="Investigation launched"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DataAnalysis" name="Perform data analysis"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_Interviews" name="Conduct interviews"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" name="Site visits required?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SiteVisits" name="Conduct site visits"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge" name="Merge: investigation activities"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Investigation" name="Investigation completed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_01" sourceRef="Start_Investigation" targetRef="Task_DataAnalysis"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_02" sourceRef="Task_DataAnalysis" targetRef="Task_Interviews"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_03" sourceRef="Task_Interviews" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_04" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" targetRef="Task_SiteVisits"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_05" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Split" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_06" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisits" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inv_07" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit_Merge" targetRef="End_Investigation"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Investigation_Merge" name="Merge: all risks addressed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompileReport" name="Compile audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportMerge" name="Merge: report for director review"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewReport" name="Review audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportDecision" name="Report approved?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateReport" name="Update report according to revisions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeFinalReport" name="Distribute final report to executive board"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveFinalReport" name="Archive final report"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_AuditInitiated" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareStatements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_PrepareStatements" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Join" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_Review_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ReviewSubmission" targetRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancy_Split" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarifications" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split" targetRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split" targetRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Split" targetRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskAssessment_Join" targetRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" targetRef="SubProcess_Investigation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Investigation_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="SubProcess_Investigation" targetRef="Gateway_Investigation_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Gateway_Investigation_Merge" targetRef="Task_CompileReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_CompileReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportMerge" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportDecision" targetRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" name="Revisions required" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportDecision" targetRef="Task_UpdateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_UpdateReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Task_DistributeFinalReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveFinalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveFinalReport" targetRef="End_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
